title: Ewald Sphere Construction
desc: Rotate a crystal relative to the X-ray beam; a reflection occurs wherever a reciprocal-lattice point touches the Ewald sphere. Explore sc, bcc, fcc and hexagonal lattices in 2D and 3D.

title: Magnetization Reversal (Stoner–Wohlfarth)
desc: Single-domain particle with uniaxial anisotropy. Sweep the field and watch the magnetization track the energy minimum, flip, and trace the hysteresis loop. Tune the field angle, anisotropy strength and field amplitude; show energy, vector and m(h) panels.

title: Precessional Switching (LLG)
desc: Thin-film macrospin: drive the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation with a field along y (perpendicular to the initial M ∥ x) and in-plane anisotropy (easy axis x). Watch M precess around the effective field, follow the energy-conserving α=0 orbit, and see the h_K/2 switching threshold. Interactive 3D sphere.

title: FMR – Magnetization Precession
desc: Ferromagnetic resonance: the magnetization precesses around the effective field until damping returns it to equilibrium. Pick a geometry (sphere, thin film, needle, ellipsoid), static field and damping, and watch the orbit in 3D or driven by an RF field. Shows the Kittel resonance frequency and decay time.
